hypotheses.justification: Split on whether ν is s-finite. In the positive case, install that instance and use the original proof. Otherwise, Measure.prod (Prod.lean:172–173) defines both products as zero. Also c • 0 = 0: by Measure.smul_apply and the scalar-tower identity, its value on any set is (c • 1) * 0 = 0. Thus the equality holds without hν, including for zero measures and empty types.
